suiteName: TouchBridge P3-01 to P3-03 Runtime & Gesture Validation Suite

testResults.details: Verified non-boolean explicit domain representations with decoupled UserIntent and RuntimeCapability.

testResults.details: Profile #79846407 loads accurately; geometry alterations correctly trigger STALE state (Resolution changed (Profile was 1280x960, Active is 1920x1080)).

testResults.details: Mapped Sensor (0.5, 0.5) -> Local CG (640.3, 479.3), Global CG (2432.3, 639.3).

testResults.details: Verified 0.0 pt cursor tolerance guard and immediate violation detection when delta > 0.001 pt.
testResults.name: Test 4: Safety Invariants & Pointer Isolation

testResults.details: Initial launch invariant preserved: Hardware is Ready (Ready) but Engine is DISABLED (Intent=Disabled). Enable transitions to Ready; Disable strictly forces Engine=Disabled.
testResults.name: Test 5: Explicit Enable/Disable Invariant Gate

testResults.details: Disconnect safely resets contacts and suspends engine (Suspended (Touchscreen disconnected)); Reconnect restores available state (Connected (USB2IIC_CTP_CONTROL)) and recovers engine (Ready) without restart.
testResults.name: Test 6: Device Lifecycle Disconnect/Reconnect Recovery

testResults.details: Incompatible display geometry or missing calibration strictly suspends interaction (Suspended (Calibration in progress)).

testResults.details: Displays found: 2. Target: "TYPE C" (#79846407).

testResults.details: Movement of 5.0 pt (< 18.0 pt threshold) remains in POSSIBLE_TAP state; no premature pan action emitted.

testResults.details: Movement over threshold on unsupported surface transitions to UNSUPPORTED_PAN; suppresses action with zero mouse/wheel synthesis.

testResults.details: Early bounded discovery captures both actionable child (AXButton) and scrollable ancestor (AXScrollArea) in a single pass.

testResults.details: TouchGestureRecognizer safely rejects concurrent secondary contacts; active primary contact is preserved without corruption.
